applicabilityAwareEvidenceMetric.definition: The same evidence inventory with only explicit record-class exclusions removed from the denominator. Uncertain applicability remains not-evidenced.

rules.rationale: An Open Geography boundary, code or lookup asset is a geospatial reference product, not a statistical population or universe.

evidenceSlotMetric.definition: Population of the 14 existing quality_evidence boolean slots across every record; this is evidence availability, not statistical accuracy.

explorerDatasetDisplayMetric.definition: Fixed dataset-detail fields that Explorer can render as a metadata gap. This diagnostic includes duplicated and inapplicable generic fields.

explorerDatasetDynamicProvenanceMetric.definition: Values in the dynamic provenance rows rendered by Explorer (up to 14 per record).

explorerPublisherDisplayMetric.definition: Fixed publisher-detail fields that Explorer can render as a metadata gap.

explorerResourceDisplayMetric.definition: Fixed resource-detail fields that Explorer can render as a metadata gap. Most are generic catalogue fields and can be inapplicable to source links.

explorerResourceDynamicProvenanceMetric.definition: Values in the dynamic provenance rows rendered by Explorer (up to 14 per record).

explorerSearchFacetMetric.definition: Bundle static-search facet fields whose missing value is shown as Not specified. This metric preserves nested OKF-ONS field semantics.

explorerSearchResultDisplayMetric.definition: Fixed search-result fields that Explorer can render as a metadata gap. These duplicate canonical records and are not added to the evidence KPI.
